profile.headline: Data Scientist
profile.summary:
I am a Data Analyst/Data Scientist employing a unique combination of skills and experiences to build analytics models and visualizations for companies that want to do more with data to improve their bottom line.  I lead descriptive and predictive analytics and reporting/visualization projects for strategic initiatives deemed mission-critical for the business. My work includes the extract, transformation, and loading (ETL) of data from multiple sources. I am skilled at collaborating with business and technical partners to develop hypotheses, build and test models, and present insights and recommendations. I have experience working on cross-functional teams in large global matrixed organizations developing data-driven cultures.

Analytics | ETL | Business Intelligence | Machine Learning
Regression Models | Linear Regression Models | Logistic Regression Models
Classification Models | Decision Tree Models | Forest Models | Boosted Models
Clustering Models | A/B Testing Models | Time Series Forecasting Models
Visualization | Performance Dashboards | Interactive Dashboards
Process Improvement | Project Management | Change Management 
Cross-functional Teams | Sourcing & Procurement
Alteryx | Tableau | Power BI | R | SQL | SAP Business Objects

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Develop Business Intelligence solutions that provide operational insights and enable data based decision making. Solutions include ETL, analytics, and visualization.

positions.title: Data Analyst
positions.description:
Identify ROI-based opportunities, shape strategic decisions, benchmark performance, and build analytic models and integrated dashboards using Alteryx, Tableau, Power BI, and Excel.
▪	Developed data cubes and interactive analysis dashboards to identify savings projects for 4 clients that achieved better than 3:1 ROI. 
▪	Cleansed, normalized, validated 31.5M invoice, PO, inventory, location, and item master records using SQL/Alteryx on latest client engagement.
▪	Developed transportation model visualizations in Tableau that provided visibility to routes, volume, and costs
▪	Developed interactive inventory heatmap-treemap identifying slow moving/obsolete inventory with $2.7M revenue opportunity.

positions.title: Managing Principal
positions.description:
Developed Regression, Decision Tree, Forest, Boosted, Time-series (forecasting), and Cluster Models.
▪	Provided consulting services to Fortune 500 global Real Estate Firm; managed analytics projects with cross-functional teams including global roll-out of enterprise analytics platform across 45 countries.
▪	Participated in strategy sessions, business modeling, architecture development and implementation; delivered programs increasing user adoption and generating $5.7M in sales revenue. 
▪	Platform earned client CIO 100 award from CIO Magazine.

positions.title: Regional Head of Shared Services Center
positions.description:
Managed 4 customer support teams with 60 people, including a 24-7 global support call center. Promoted to address continuing issues with on-time payments and data integrity; instituted more proactive and detailed approach to reporting and performance management through improved data quality, analytics, and visiblity. Supported procure-to-pay activities across North America and Latin America. Part of Shared Services Global Leadership Team.       
▪	Directed all aspects transaction data analytics including strategy, thought leadership, and implementation of hypothesis-driven analytics projects. 
▪	Established new call center to support North and South America; implemented global knowledge management system using serviceNOW to improve First Call Resolution (FCR) and reduce Average Handle Time (ATH)
▪	Upgraded performance reporting processes with multi-dimensional analysis, developed methodologies and structured data frameworks with SAP/BW, Tableau, and Excel. 
▪	Increased #1 key metric in South America by 17% while reducing headcount by 20% in 7 months by leveraging descriptive data analytics methods.  
▪	Implemented Six Sigma Project to reduce order and payment processing time; attained highest rate of on-time supplier payment of any Ericcson region with 98%.  
▪	Drove development of global Shared Serviced Center Strategy in collaboration with regional leaders; boosted quality and standardization while reaching all stretch performance targets over 3 years. 
▪	Ranked #2 out of 11 global regions based on customer satisfaction.

positions.title: Director of Sourcing Development
positions.description:
Led a cross-functional team with 4 managers and developed a data-based approach to sourcing efforts. Leveraged analytics and reporting tools, focused on spend and trend analysis to maximize profitability. Developed 3-year road map.       

▪	Improved analytics and performance reporting to support visibility of critical information, faster reporting, and data-based decision-making. 
▪	Built relationships with international managers and facilitated cross-functional teams to coordinate global, regional, and local projects.
▪	Led and participated in global initiatives to drive process improvement, performance management, and competency development. 
▪	Deployed spend analysis and category strategies that achieved 90% target for managed spend (in US dollars). 
▪	Group ranked #1 for performance out of all global regions

positions.title: Head of Indirect Materials and Services Sourcing (IM&S)
positions.description:
▪	Reduced costs by implementing data-driven sourcing methods and category strategies that integrated supply base management, demand management, and total cost management initiatives.
▪	Created vendor management program focused on performance metrics, vendor scorecards, and monitoring. 
▪	Implemented analytics project that increased contracted payment terms by 28 days and improved cash flows.
▪	Achieved savings targets for 3 consecutive years.

positions.title: Senior Consultant, Manager
positions.description:
Consulted on strategic sourcing and eCommerce projects for 500 companies. Projects included:
▪	Managed spend analytics project for $1.5B property management company; achieved $2.8M in annual savings across 5 facilities management categories. 
▪	Implemented spend cube and reverse auction tools for $9B utility company; delivered 15% savings on pilot auction.
•	Conceptualized and implemented e-sourcing solution for major auto supplier; reduced sourcing cycle time by 25%.
•	Implemented procure-to-pay solutions for SAP and Oracle ERP systems; analyzed business processes and transaction data; recommended target categories and suppliers for onboarding; reduced transaction costs by 3-5%  and provided critical spend data for strategic sourcing projects.

positions.title: Senior Consultant
positions.description: Collaborated on or managed various client projects including package implementation, QA testing, M&A integration, e-commerce, and sourcing & procurement
